mutations.name: a thaw-waiting reserver still orders its peers
kills: a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) replays the deadlock: R waits on deploy skew, so it neither orders S nor holds the deploy that would release it
a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) stops ordering peers under a freeze-only wait, but stays busy since no deploy ends a freeze

mutations.name: a deploy-skew wait still counts as busy
kills: a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) replays the deadlock: R waits on deploy skew, so it neither orders S nor holds the deploy that would release it

mutations.name: a skew gate at an older head still counts as the wait
kills: a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) orders again and is busy when its CI read has moved past the head the skew gate was at

mutations.name: an active write beside the settle step is ignored
kills: a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) fails closed while any write step is active beside the settle wait

mutations.name: any thaw wait leaves the busy count
kills: a run waiting at its head on a deploy or a thaw (TP-4778) stops ordering peers under a freeze-only wait, but stays busy since no deploy ends a freeze
